aboutGame.title: What is Jujutsu School Anomaly?
paragraphs: Jujutsu School Anomaly is a Roblox observation-horror game developed by Centurion Kitchen. You take the night shift at a cursed sorcery academy where every corridor may hide an anomaly, and your only weapon is a sharp eye. Inspect visitors, check IDs and permits, and decide whether to advance or turn back.

Each clean sector pushes your counter forward, while a single missed distortion or false report resets the run. Anomalies range from displaced props and inverted portraits to looping hallways and hostile entities, and they escalate across four shift phases. With multiple endings, a hidden True Ending, and a climactic final boss, the academy rewards patience and precision over speed.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Jujutsu School Anomaly.

items.question: What is Jujutsu School Anomaly?
items.answer: Jujutsu School Anomaly is a Roblox observation-horror game by Centurion Kitchen. You work the night shift at a cursed academy, inspecting visitors, checking IDs, and deciding whether each corridor is clean or corrupted before a single mistake resets your run.

items.question: How do I tell if a corridor is anomalous in Jujutsu School Anomaly?
items.answer: Memorise the clean baseline first, then compare lighting, noticeboards, lockers, and audio against it. Any flicker, inverted talisman, or reversed chanting means you should turn back through the entrance.

items.question: How many endings does Jujutsu School Anomaly have?
items.answer: Jujutsu School Anomaly has multiple endings, including The Endless Detention, The Blind Escape, Purification Protocol, The Exorcist's Awakening (True Ending), and The Forgotten Sorcerer secret ending.

items.question: Are there working codes in Jujutsu School Anomaly?
items.answer: No confirmed active Jujutsu School Anomaly codes have been released yet. When codes do drop, this wiki will list the rewards and the exact redemption steps.

items.question: How do I survive later Jujutsu School Anomaly shifts?
items.answer: Later Jujutsu School Anomaly shifts spawn anomalies faster and add compound threats. Slow your sweep, verify suspicious changes twice, and never sprint while retreating from a manifested entity.

items.question: Does Jujutsu School Anomaly support co-op?
items.answer: Yes. Jujutsu School Anomaly matches support up to 24 players, so you can split corridors with friends and cross-check each other's reports.
